title: Cadpole: parametric CAD for bots
description: Cadpole is parametric CAD for bots. Your coding agent builds the model, sets its parameters, measures it, renders it and runs its tests; you watch in 3D, drag a parameter and say what you want. Parts and assemblies, buildings and plans.
card: Your agent builds it and checks it. You steer.

headline: Parametric CAD
for bots.
hero.sub: Your agent builds the model and checks its own work: it measures, renders and runs the model's tests. Every dimension is a parameter. The bot sets it, you drag it, the model rebuilds.
